P.O. Jingi, P.S. Kuru, District Lohardaga, Jharkhand ... ...
CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH ------

For the Petitioner : M/s. Md. Zaid Ahmed, Advocate For the State : M/s. Achinto Sen, A.P.P.
-----
02/07.12.2024 Heard the parties 2.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Special POCSO Case No. 31 of 2024 arising out of Lohardaga (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 15 of 2024, for the offences registered under Sections 376, 333, 324, 498A, 313 & 34 of the I.P.C. and Section 3 / 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and Section 6 of the POCSO Act, pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I-cum-Special Judge, POCSO, Lohardaga.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-I-cum-Special Judge, POCSO, Lohardaga
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. The petitioner is alleged to have raped the prosecutrix on 26.01.2015.

It is alleged that the petitioner started demanding Rs. 5,00,000/- as dowry and to enforce the demand of dowry, he tortured her and ultimately, she was driven away from her matrimonial home.
4.
The allegation of rape dates back to nine years ago.

Considering the foresaid facts, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I-cum-Special Judge, POCSO, Lohardaga in connection with Special POCSO Case No. 31 of 2024 arising out of Lohardaga (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 15 of 2024.
